packages.section: Part C §7 "F-look", as amended by Part A §A11 (the look bible: the targets) and §A9 (where tunables go), with Part B's L1-L3 (the bars) and the slice gate's locks and ranked gaps 2, 6 and 11 (docs/milestones/M4-slice-gate.md)
packages.note: You own the toon and post files and their tests: game/fx/toon.gdshader, toon_light.gdshaderinc, toon_outline.gdshader, game/fx/toon_materials.gd, game/actors/rig_paint.gd, game/fx/damage_look.gd, game/fx/edge_pass.gdshader, game/fx/look_post.gd, game/level/room_kit.gd (the sun, the environment, the sky), game/level/test_room.gd, game/level/crowd_room.gd for colours and the window boxes' depth only, tools/gen_lut.gd and assets/source/look/grade.json (and the LUT it writes), the damage tiles' art in tools/gen_fx.gd (only the damage tile functions; every other effect PNG must stay byte-identical, test_fx_m4 checks it), tests/bot/look_probe.gd, new tests/bot/acts/look_tune_acts.gd (titles start 'Look:'; no title contains or is contained in another act's), the Look group's existing subgroups in tuning_data.gd (Toon, Outline, Edges, Grade and the rest; tune their DEFAULTS, add a tunable only where a feel number is still a script constant), the tests of those files when a tuned default moves a pinned number (log every change old -> new with a twin), and docs/milestones/M4-calls/F-look.md. Tune every Look tunable against the Punk at 1, 3 and 8 m in both rooms, in first person, toward the bible. In order: (1) Gate gap 2, the worst: at 1 m the Punk's front is one violet shadow band (teal reads blue, skin reads lilac). Set look_band_2 below cos(sun elevation) (0.616 today) or move the sun, and give contre-jour fronts (about half of all enemies face away from the sun whatever its azimuth) 2-3 bands, through the sun's angle, the ambient or fill, or the band levels; keep each swatch's rendered mid band within about 10 degrees of its hue (teal not blue, skin not lilac); shadows at least 40% of the lit value and tinted, never black. Record C2 front-lit and back-lit. (2) L1, the hull: 3.75 px stays; re-measure at 1, 2.5, 5 and 10 m (the cap crown reads 0.1-0.3 px under the 2.75 floor at 2.5-10 m: fix it through look_outline_near_m/far_m, not px), never above 4.5; the player's own body x0.8; and find the ink-dark wedge across the near glove at about 0.35 m in the C4 jab strike (the hull's world width inside look_outline_near_m?). (3) Gate gap 11: band edges at most 2 px at 1 m; the stippled 10-20 px edge on the forearm is the mid-to-shadow band edge dithered by the shadow map's soft filter (check the shadow filter and look_band_soft). (4) The rim lifts the Punk off the street (stepped, characters only, about +35% value); one small hard highlight on the cap and glasses, under 3% of the visible surface. (5) One ink: 3D ink renders 10-16 levels lighter than the HUD's (tonemap, fog on an unshaded hull, the cool shadow tint; P1-post measured edge (27,24,31) and fogged hull (34,29,33) against the HUD's (18,15,23)): bring the hull and edge ink within a few levels of HudStyle.INK on screen. (6) The street: dumpster (S 0.52) and crates (S 0.45) down to the bible's 0.30 street saturation with value 0.25-0.6; the dashed creases on the crowd room's 1.5 cm window boxes (deepen the boxes or raise look_edge_normal_threshold); environment edge lines 1-1.5 px; the grade (street_dusk) keeps blood and the enemy palette within ΔE76 6. (7) Gate gap 6, your half: the bloodied skin wash reads lilac and glassy, and the scuffed tile reads as camouflage on the jeans and vest; redraw those damage tiles and tune the wash so clean, bruised and bloodied read at 1 m (C5 at 100/65/30%). (8) J13, one game: retune the placeholders (Kicker, Thug, Bruiser, Boss, dummies, pipe) through the same tunables only, so they and the street and the VFX read as one style with the Punk (C7 lineup, C9 street tour). Never change: the gate's locks above, a move clip, any game state, the halftone default (off), FXAA's availability as look_aa_mode 1. Evidence: look_tune_acts.gd with the Punk at 1, 3 and 8 m in both rooms, front-lit and back-lit; re-record C1, C2, C4, C5, C6, C7 and C9 beside the before pack; L1, L2 (2-3 luma clusters on the jacket at 1 m, shadow/lit at least 0.4, hue toward the tint) and L3 (the flash's white share on a jab at 1 m at most M2's localized figure + 2 points) printed from look_probe into look.json. Done: L1-L3 in range, the full suite green, and you look at the C2, C5, C7 and C9 sheets in first person and say honestly whether they read as one game.
